newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe says euro must be launched on time.
newsitem.headline: Juppe says euro must be launched on time.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe said on Tuesday that the planned new single European currency must be launched as scheduled on January 1, 1999.
"Later it will be too late," Juppe told members of the coalition in a speech outlining the programme of his centre-right coalition.
He said the euro should be on an "equal footing with the dollar and the yen".
Juppe added that for the Europe Union to be strong, it needed to reform itself by making its institutions "less bureaucratic and more efficient".
"France has nothing to fear but everything to gain from the euro," he said, adding that France in the European Union "will always be France".

In his speech, Juppe said it was necessary to "humanise" the drive to a united Europe, giving it a social dimension and involving it in efforts to give Europeans a greater sense of prosperity and security.
